consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1992-03-23 show at The Palace was a solid performance with standout moments, particularly in the first set. While some noted issues with the second set, many praised specific songs and the overall energy of the band.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 27 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the show and highlighted specific performances, there were notable criticisms regarding the second set and some technical issues that tempered overall enthusiasm.
